name: Long subsea tiebacks with direct electrical heating
aliases: Long subsea tiebacks with direct electrical heating
applications: long hydrate-prone tiebacks in the North Sea
principle: Alternating current is passed through the pipeline wall to keep fluids above hydrate temperature or to re-heat them after a shutdown. Tyrihans is the longest DEH line described, 43 km, 18 inch, about 10 MW, with Huldra (16 km) before it.

source.note: Offshore magazine, Direct heating safeguards flow through harsh-environment pipelines
Offshore magazine, Direct heating safeguards flow through harsh-environment pipelines

performance.metric: longest electrically trace-heated (ETH) pipe-in-pipe production pipeline (Fenja tieback, for comparison with DEH)
performance.basis: 37-km ETH pipe-in-pipe pipeline for Neptune Energy's Fenja field installed and tested in 2020-21 campaigns, claimed by Neptune as the world's longest to date for that technology; tieback to Equinor's Njord A platform — a different active-heating technology from DEH

source.note: Offshore magazine, Record-length heated pipeline installed at Fenja oil field, 3 August 2021 (read 28 October 2026)

limitations: Article is older; qualification for over 100 km and 2,000 m was an expectation then
